admission.justification: Unit tests and synthetic fixtures verify comment/literal skipping, attribute matching, unclosed-comment rejection and challenge-vs-solution routing, preventing missed forbidden tokens or false positives in comments and literals.

applicability: Lexical static scanning of Lean 4 source files for forbidden tokens and external-code attributes in src/rh_pipeline/audit/static_scan.py.
conditions: Line comments, nested block comments, double-quoted strings, raw strings, char literals and Unicode primed identifiers are lexed before matching the nine forbidden tokens or depth-1 extern/implemented_by attributes.

Exactly one primary challenge file (Challenge.lean at repo root or legacy src/Challenge.lean) must exist; entry scope scans src/Statements.lean, src/Main.lean, the resolved primary challenge file and any comparator/FormalConjectures*.lean files when comparator/ exists; full scope scans src/**/*.lean, the resolved primary challenge file and optional comparator/**/*.lean excluding scripts/; only sorry in CHALLENGE_FILES (Challenge.lean, src/Challenge.lean, comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean) routes to challenge_findings.
exclusions: Interpolated string expressions (s!"...{expr}...") are skipped as opaque string literals, unclosed string literals do not raise AuditScanError, and root-level .lean files other than Challenge.lean outside src/ and comparator/ are outside full scope.
statement: The Lean 4 lexical static scanner skips line comments, nested block comments, strings, raw strings, and char literals without desyncing on identifier primes, detects word-bounded forbidden tokens and extern/implemented_by attribute forms, raises AuditScanError on unclosed block comments, supports entry and full scopes across condensed (root Challenge.lean, optional comparator/) and legacy layouts (excluding scripts/), and routes challenge sorrys separately from non-sorry forbidden tokens.
title: Comment- and literal-aware Lean 4 static scan and challenge/solution split
